project: Wuxia Life P23 Experience Acceptance And Live Balance Closure
description: Complete an experience-acceptance and live-balance closure pass for wuxia-life by auditing the current player-facing acceptance surfaces, defining explicit acceptance and comparison rules, extending profile-first acceptance and reporting structures with minimal theme-neutral support, shipping representative comparison and live-balance samples, and proving through validation artifacts that future tuning waves can be judged by measurable experience improvement rather than content volume alone without adding UI work, a new theme, or a large runtime rewrite.

userStories.title: Audit full-life experience acceptance surfaces
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a read-only audit of current wuxia experience acceptance surfaces so that P23 targets real player-facing control gaps instead of adding more raw metrics.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit current acceptance surfaces across archetype quality, replay quality, route differentiation, stage pacing, mid or late payoff, legacy closure, and endgame aftertaste
Record which surfaces already have explicit evidence versus which surfaces still depend mainly on impressionistic judgment
Save the audit under docs/test-reports/ or docs/designs/
Do not modify gameplay behavior in this story

userStories.title: Audit measurable versus inferred comparison surfaces
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a read-only audit of measurable, partially measurable, and inferred experience-comparison surfaces so that later P23 implementation targets the weakest evidence boundaries first.
acceptanceCriteria: Mark representative experience surfaces as explicitly measurable, partially measurable, or inferred only through review
Identify where current gates can pass without clearly demonstrating player-experience improvement
Record the main risks where more content can land without the experience becoming materially better
Save the audit under docs/test-reports/ or docs/designs/
Do not modify gameplay behavior in this story

userStories.title: Write representative experience-dimension rules
userStories.description: As a designer, I want explicit representative experience dimensions so that future P23 acceptance work evaluates one coherent player-facing surface instead of scattered intuitions.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the representative experience dimensions in scope for the first P23 pass
Define how acceptance combines early-life variation, route differentiation, consequence weight, legacy resonance, and endgame aftertaste
Save the rules under docs/designs/ or docs/

userStories.title: Write meaningful-improvement and deferral rules
userStories.description: As a designer, I want explicit improvement and deferral rules so that future tuning waves are judged by experience gain rather than raw volume growth.
acceptanceCriteria: Define what counts as a meaningful player-experience improvement versus a merely larger content update
Define which acceptance or live-balance problems are explicitly deferred beyond P23
Define how acceptance should resolve tension between improving weak dimensions and protecting already strong dimensions
Save the rules under docs/designs/ or docs/

userStories.title: Define long-term balance indicator set

acceptanceCriteria: Define 3-5 representative long-term balance indicators across archetype stability, replay quality, stage pacing health, mid or late payoff strength, and endgame or legacy resonance
Ensure each indicator has a concrete interpretation for future tuning review
Ensure the indicator set is suitable for future wave-to-wave comparison

Do not require runtime redesign in this story
